record.title: Khosravi and Chazzabeh pilgrimage restrictions during Iraqi unrest, October 2019
record.scope: Pilgrim departures at two crossings with different reopening phases
record.direction: Iran to Iraq; reverse direction unresolved
record.movement: Pilgrims travelling from Iran into Iraq
record.exceptions: Chazzabeh had an earlier reported reopening; return travel and cargo are not established.
record.imposing_authority: Iranian border authorities; Khosravi suspension reportedly requested by Iraq
record.enforcement: Official accounts describe closure and later pilgrim departures.
record.relationship: Distinct from the later October 30 Mehran truck-entry measure.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no current closure status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Pilgrim safety during Iraqi unrest and Baghdad curfew.
record.context: Early-October protests prompted temporary restrictions before the Arbaeen pilgrimage.
record.uncertainty: Reports differ on Wednesday-night versus Thursday onset and Sunday versus Monday restoration. October 7 is a documented Khosravi pilgrim-departure milestone, not the first reopening of both gates.
